hits.about: Valia at Dubai Creek Harbour is a residential complex developed by Emaar Properties, offering 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments next to Dubai Square Mall. hits.about: Lia by Avenew Development is a boutique beachfront residential project, located on Dubai Islands, one of Dubai’s newest master-planned coastal destinations. hits.about: Seslia Tower - a luxury project by developer Tiger Group, located in JVT. The complex is a 36-storey tower designed in a modern style. The main feature of the unique facades are glass panels and clear lines of balconies.All residences of the complex have unique layouts designed to provide residents with maximum comfort and convenience. High-quality materials are used in the interior decoration, which harmoniously combine with each other and create a cosy atmosphere.Among the exclusive amenities of the complex, residents will find a swimming pool, a gym with modern equipment, a children's playground and many recreational areas with barbecue facilities. The complex has 24-hour security and car parking. There are cafes and restaurants, retail outlets, kindergartens and schools within walking distance.The area is located near the main motorway of Dubai - Sheikh Zayed Road, thanks to which residents will be able to get to the objects of social and entertainment infrastructure of the city. JBR Beach and Palm Jumeirah are 20 minutes away by car, the Mall Of Emirates shopping centre is 15 minutes away and Downtown, Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall are approximately 25 minutes away.
hits.title: Seslia Tower
